renders._yaml:
- component: advanced_viz
  id: controlfreec_profile
  title: Copy number profile
  description: |-
    Each point is a genomic window: its log2 copy ratio along the chromosomes, with the called segments drawn over it and the B-allele frequency underneath. It answers where the genome has gained or lost copies.
    How to read: windows around zero are copy neutral, and a run of windows shifted up or down forms a gain or a loss. Segments are coloured by the predicted copy number. A BAF split away from 0.5 on a shifted segment supports a real alteration and marks loss of heterozygosity.
    Lines and annotations: the dashed lines mark log2 ratios of 0.32 and -0.42, the midpoints between 2 and 3 copies and between 2 and 1 copies. They are an arithmetic reference from Control-FREEC's copy number as ratio times ploidy, taken at ploidy 2, and not thresholds the tool uses to call.
    Note: Control-FREEC calls copy number from the ratio and the ploidy of the run, so for another ploidy or a subclonal sample these lines move.
    Source: http://boevalab.inf.ethz.ch/FREEC/tutorial.html and https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22155870/
  kind: cnv_profile
  config:
    gain_threshold: 0.32
    loss_threshold: -0.42
  roles:
    sample: sample
    chrom: chrom
    start: start
    end: end
    log2: log2
    baf: baf
    copy_number: copy_number
    segment: segment
    label: label

- component: card
  id: controlfreec_log2_spread
  title: Log2 ratio spread
  description: |-
    The hero number is the range of window log2 copy ratios, and the box shows their quartiles. It answers how far the genome departs from copy neutral.
    How to read: a box tight around zero with a long range means a mostly neutral genome with a few alterations. A box shifted off zero points to a wrong ploidy or normalisation, so check the profile.
    Source: http://boevalab.inf.ethz.ch/FREEC/tutorial.html
  column: log2
  aggregation: range
  aggregations:
  - box_plot_stats
  secondary_layout: box_plot
  filter_expr: col('segment') == 'bin'
  caption: range, with the spread

- component: card
  id: controlfreec_cn_mix
  title: Windows by copy number
  description: |-
    The hero number is the count of windows, the bar splits them by the copy number Control-FREEC predicted, and the strip gives the median and highest copy number. It answers how much of the genome is neutral, gained or lost.
    How to read: a bar dominated by the neutral state means a quiet genome. Large shares of other copy numbers mean wide alterations or aneuploidy.
    Source: http://boevalab.inf.ethz.ch/FREEC/tutorial.html
  column: copy_number
  aggregation: count
  aggregations:
  - median
  - max
  secondary_layout: composition
  breakdown_col: copy_number
  filter_expr: col('segment') == 'bin'
  caption: windows, by predicted copy number

- component: table
  title: Copy number windows
  description: |-
    Each row is a genomic window or a called segment, with its sample, chromosome, start and end, log2 ratio, B-allele frequency and predicted copy number. It answers the exact values behind the profile.
    How to read: filter by the segment column to list the called segments, or by chromosome to read one region window by window.
    Source: http://boevalab.inf.ethz.ch/FREEC/tutorial.html
  columns:
  - sample
  - chrom
  - start
  - end
  - log2
  - baf
  - copy_number
  - segment
